summary:
We developed 'Field Shift', a full-stack smart agriculture web platform built with React, TypeScript, and Express that connects directly to live NASA POWER climate data using farm coordinates. Our platform features an advanced Decision Engine across core modules—including Earth Intelligence, Decision Studio, Action Center, and Reports—that analyzes soil, water, and climate factors to recommend and rank the best-suited crops for each farmer's land. To ensure full accessibility for all farmers, including those who cannot read or write, we integrated voice recording features to describe their land easily, mobile AI Field Scanning, and a step-by-step interactive onboarding guide that walks them through setting up and using the platform effortlessly.
Field Shift bridges the gap between complex NASA satellite data and everyday farming decisions. Instead of relying on guesswork or expensive sensors, farmers get live climate and soil insights translated into simple recommendations—telling them the best crop to plant, when to irrigate, and how to prevent crop stress. With voice features and mobile scanning, we make space technology accessible to every farmer, even those who cannot read or write.
Our solution is vital because agriculture faces severe threats from climate change, water scarcity, and rising input costs. By empowering small-scale farmers with free, real-time NASA climate and soil data,
details:
Field Shift helps farmers make smarter crop rotation decisions. It analyzes farm conditions using NASA environmental data, soil information, and crop characteristics to identify suitable crops and compare rotation options. It also provides tools such as voice input, mobile field scanning, and an intelligent decision engine to turn environmental information into practical recommendations.Voice & Accessibility Features: Allows users to record voice notes to describe their

land or crops easily.

Interactive Onboarding Guide: A step-by-step walkthrough upon first registration to

introduce users to the platform's interface and help them easily set up their farms.

Mobile Scanning: Enables users to perform field scans directly from their mobile devices

Modern Web Stack: Built as a fully integrated web application using React, Vite,

TypeScript, and an Express server layer.

NASA Climate Integration: Features live integration with NASA POWER API to fetch

real environmental data based on farm coordinates.

Advanced Decision Engine: Evaluates crops based on water, climate, soil, and

seasonal factors to calculate suitability indices.

Core Functional Modules: Includes specialized views for Farm Capture, Earth

Intelligence, AI Field Scan, Decision Studio, Action Center, and Reports.

ADVANTAGESThe goal of Field Shift is to help farmers make informed crop rotation decisions by analyzing environmental conditions, soil information, and crop characteristics. It aims to improve soil health, support sustainable farming practices, and help farmers adapt to climate change.
